name: SALTWALL PARLAY HOUSE: Shelf Combat & Numbers
description: A converted water-reclamation substation in Saltwall District that operates as Tier 1's most reliable all-in-one gambling operation, running combat odds, daily number draws, and crude prediction markets on district crime quotas and Shelf weather events. The operation is run by a rotating council of seven bookmakers under the Gutwall Syndicate's loose protection, with slates chalked fresh each morning on reclaimed plasteel panels. No BCI required — all wagers recorded on paper ledger carbon-copies, making it functionally immune to corporate data sweeps.
story_hooks: A bookmaker's ledger carbon-copy surfaces containing what appears to be coded intelligence on a corponation black-site operation — someone has been using number slips to pass information for years.

The Gutwall Syndicate is pressuring the council to accept a silent OmniPhi partnership that would launder the operation clean but hand over patron data; the seven bookmakers are deadlocked four to three.

A player wins an impossible parlay — combat outcome, exact crime quota, and a freak Shelf weather event all hit simultaneously — and the payout would bankrupt the house; the question is whether the bet was luck or advance knowledge.
